title: 第9章 诡异黑焱第10章 风雨欲来
content_zh:
翌日，清晨。
余烬从修炼之中醒过来，感受了一下身体变化，虽然一直没办法突破，可他这三年来从没有一刻松懈过。
如今不仅是为了追寻娘亲失踪的真相，一年后还要面对柳王府的提亲，留给他的时间不多，甚至对于现在的他而言，堪称绝望！
娘亲当年的失踪，年仅四五岁的他无能为力，如今少年归来，再次面对有人要把妹妹余小蝶抢走，哪怕付出性命，他也绝不会答应！
更何况，拥有仙笼的他未必会输！
等余烬推开房门的时候，妹妹余小蝶正俏生生地站在门外。
他这才想起答应余小蝶陪她出去玩，兄妹俩人相视一笑，然后并肩朝着侯府之外而去，而侍女陈青不近不远地跟在后面，生怕打扰到二人。
正当他们要走出侯府大门的时候，数道不合时宜的身影，正站在前面等着他们。
前面的几人都是余氏子弟，那余洋从人群中走了出来，皮笑肉不笑地看向余烬，“你身边那条老狗呢，没它护着你也敢出来乱跑？”
还没等余烬说话，余小蝶的脸色唰得一下就沉了下去，她冷冷地看着余洋，“你们要是再拦在前面，别怪我不客气！”
余洋眯起眼，似乎知道余小蝶不好惹，但也没认怂，只是不慌不忙地说道：“小蝶小姐的路，我们这些旁系子弟自然不敢拦着，但是有人有话要说。”
余烬目光看向众人身后，在大门的台阶上，正坐着一个穿着藏青长袍，身材修长的年轻人。
“余林？”陈青认出那人来，同样出身余氏旁系的余林。
余小蝶轻声道：“余林的天赋不咋地，只是二境后期，倒是他哥余峰还有点名气。”
余烬点了点头，没有多说什么。
“好久不见了，小蝶小姐。”余林朝着余小蝶笑了笑，“你这是打算去哪里？”
余小蝶脸色清冷，“这似乎与你无关，让你的人走开。“
余林从台阶上站起，“哈哈别误会，我是来通知小蝶小姐一声，原本月底的余氏府内演武提前了，而且这次由三爷主持，城主府和李侯府都会有人来参观，家族那边放话了，所有还在府内的子弟都必须参加。”
说完，他轻描淡写地看了余烬一眼。
余小蝶微微蹙眉，一丝不悦在脸上闪过，却听旁边的余烬笑道：“我也正好也有点事要出去处理，小蝶你先去参加演武，我们可以下次再一起出去玩，哥答应你就算真的要走，也会带着你走。”

原本蹙着眉的余小蝶，瞬间眉头舒展开来，这才笑着螓首微点同意下来。
余洋突然喝道：“余烬！你没听见林哥说什么吗？所有府内的子弟都必须参加！”
余烬目光平淡，“余氏的会武，关我余烬什么事？”
余洋愣了一下，盯着余烬良久，“我知道了，是不是身边没跟着那条老狗，连上演武台的勇气都没有了，也对，毕竟你是一个只有一境的废物……”
还没等周围响起哄笑声，余洋的瞳孔猛地睁大，一只拳头以快到不可思议的速度轰在了他的脑袋上！
嘭！
一声轰然巨响，众人还没反应过来，余烬已是将余洋一拳砸在墙上。
“你，你竟敢在府内逞凶！”几位余氏子弟倒吸一口凉气，谁也没料到余洋会被一拳打倒！
就连余小蝶也是微微愣了一下，全场只有身后的陈青显得很理所当然。
余烬松开拳头，被砸在墙上已是昏死过去的余洋，如同一滩烂泥般瘫软在地上。
content_en:
The next day, early morning.
Yu Yan woke up from training and felt the changes in his body. Although he had been unable to break through, he had never relaxed for a moment in the past three years.
Now he is not only pursuing the truth about his mother's disappearance, but also facing the marriage proposal from Prince Liu's Mansion a year later. There is not much time left for him, and even for him now, it is despairing!
He was only four or five years old and could do nothing about his mother's disappearance. Now that the boy has returned, he once again faces someone who wants to take his sister Yu Xiaodie away. Even if it costs his life, he will never agree!
What's more, with the Immortal Cage, he may not lose!
When Yu Yan opened the door, his younger sister Yu Xiaodie was standing outside the door in a lively manner.
Only then did he remember that he had promised Yu Xiaodie to go out with her. The brother and sister looked at each other and smiled, then walked side by side towards the outside of the Hou Mansion, while the maid Chen Qing followed closely, not far away, for fear of disturbing the two of them.
Just as they were about to walk out of the gate of the Hou Mansion, several inappropriate figures were standing in front waiting for them.
The people in front were all children of the Yu family. Then Yu Yang walked out of the crowd and looked at Yu Hu with a smile on his face, "Where is that old dog next to you? How dare you run around without it protecting you?"
Before Yu Yan could say anything, Yu Xiaodie's face suddenly darkened. She looked at Yu Yang coldly, "If you stop in front again, don't blame me for being rude!"
Yu Yang narrowed his eyes, as if he knew that Yu Xiaodie was not easy to mess with, but he did not give in. He just said calmly: "Of course we, the descendants of the sideline, dare not block Miss Xiaodie's way, but there are people who have something to say."
Yan Yan looked behind everyone. Sitting on the steps of the gate was a slender young man wearing a navy blue robe.
"Yu Lin?" Chen Qing recognized the man, Yu Lin, who was also from a branch of the Yu family.
Yu Xiaodie said softly: "Yu Lin's talent is not that good, he is only in the late second realm, but his brother Yu Feng is still somewhat famous."
Ember nodded and said nothing more.
"Long time no see, Miss Xiaodie." Yu Lin smiled at Yu Xiaodie, "Where are you going?"
Yu Xiaodie's face was cold, "This seems to have nothing to do with you, let your people go away."
Yu Lin stood up from the steps, "Haha, don't get me wrong, I'm here to inform Miss Xiaodie that the martial arts performance in the Yu Family Mansion at the end of the month has been brought forward, and this time it will be hosted by the Third Master. People from the City Lord's Mansion and Lihou Mansion will come to visit. The family has announced that all the children still in the manor must participate."
After speaking, he glanced at Ember lightly.
Yu Xiaodie frowned slightly, and a trace of displeasure flashed across her face, but she heard Yi Yan next to her smile: "I also happen to have something to go out to deal with. Xiaodie, you go to participate in the martial arts performance first, and we can go out together next time. I promise you that even if you really want to leave, I will take you with me."
Yu Xiaodie, who was originally frowning, suddenly relaxed his brows, and then smiled and nodded in agreement.
Yu Yang suddenly shouted: "Ember! Didn't you hear what Brother Lin said? All the children in the mansion must participate!"
Yi Yan's eyes were dull, "What does Yu's martial arts training have to do with me, Yi Yan?"
Yu Yang was stunned for a moment and stared at the embers for a long time. "I understand. Without that old dog by my side, I don't even have the courage to perform in martial arts. That's right. After all, you are a waste with only one level..."
Before anyone could burst into laughter, Yu Yang's pupils suddenly opened wide, and a fist hit his head at an incredible speed!
Bang!
There was a loud bang, and before anyone could react, Yu Yan punched Yu Yang against the wall.
"You, how dare you show off in the house!" Several Yu family disciples gasped. No one expected that Yu Yang would be knocked down with one punch!
Even Yu Xiaodie was slightly stunned. Only Chen Qing behind him in the audience seemed to take it for granted.
Yu Yan unclenched his fist and was knocked unconscious after being hit on the wall.The ocean lay limp on the ground like a puddle of mud.
